title: DAOS v4 Intent / 变更意图
description: Schema for a network change intent in DAOS v4. Every intent is a declarative description of a desired change to the network infrastructure.

id.description: Unique intent identifier (UUID) / 意图唯一标识

action.description: Network operation to execute / 要执行的网络操作

target_node.description: Target network device / 目标网络设备

trust_score.description: Historical trust score / 历史信任分数

target_network.description: Target network in CIDR notation / 目标网络 CIDR 格式

risk_level.description: Assessed risk level / 风险评估等级

rollback_steps.description: Ordered list of rollback instructions / 有序的回滚指令列表

command.description: Rollback CLI command / 回滚 CLI 命令

expected_outcome.description: Expected success state / 预期成功状态

simulation_required.description: Whether a simulation run is mandatory / 是否必须模拟运行

change_window_override.description: Optional override for the change window / 变更窗口的可选覆盖

start_utc.description: Override start time HH:MM UTC / 覆盖起始时间

end_utc.description: Override end time HH:MM UTC / 覆盖结束时间
